units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 2:2:6">Y. Meg. II, 73ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>קל הקילו בתְפִירָתָהּ</he> they introduced a lenient practice with regard to sewing it (the scroll of Esther).
<cite ref="Shabbat 75a:2">Sabb. 75ᵃ</cite> <he>חוט של ת׳</he>, v. <cite ref="M03039"><he>מָתַח</he></cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 13:2">Sabb. XIII, 2</cite> <he>התופר שתי ת׳</he> he that sews two stitches; <he>הקורע … שתי ת׳</he> he that tears with the intention of sewing the pieces together to the length of two stitches; a. e.
